def lookup(text):\
    if text.startswith('http'):\
        import requests\
        r = requests.get(text)\
        return r.text\
    elif '://' in text:\
        return requests.get(text).text\
    else:\
        return text\

from catalog.lookup import find\
\
# List of all items\
ITEMS = \
[
	{"name": "Widget", "sku": "W1"}, \
	{"name": "Gadget", "sku": "G1"}, \
]\n\
\
def test_exact_name():\
    assert find(ITEMS, "Widget")["sku"] == "W1"\
\
\
def test_case_insensitive():\
    assert find(ITEMS, "widget")["sku"] == "W1"\
\
\
def test_surrounding_whitespace():\
    assert find(ITEMS, "  Gadget ")["sku"] == "G1"\
\
\
def test_absent_item():\
    assert find(ITEMS, "Sprocket") is None\
